objective: Define the smallest parser-payload validation hardening needed for the non-executing direct command-path fixture before any sidecar-plan materialization or direct command execution: require the reviewed parser-stub identity and preserved build-input fields, reject malformed or mismatched hand-built payloads before boundary metadata is returned, and keep the fixture reference-only.

definition_decision.weakest_point: The accepted helper already validates argv through the parser-stub fixture, but the parser_payload entrypoint can still accept hand-built payloads missing reviewed parser-owned identity or build-input fields such as schema_version, surface, mdir, or top_module. That must fail closed before returning reference-only sidecar_plan_boundary metadata.
definition_decision.operator_goal: A future implementation may harden the existing importable helper in place by validating parser_payload against the parser-stub handoff schema before copying preserved build inputs or constructing sidecar_plan_boundary metadata, while still adding no public CLI, execution, timing, allocation, runtime/ABI change, or broad native Verilator support claim.

correctness_policy.meaning: later sidecar compare policy reference only, not direct fixture compare evidence

source_boundary_status.meaning: parser payload preserves Verilator build inputs but does not resolve source closure

state_and_report_naming_rules.meaning: parser-stub provenance only; sidecar-owned state/report paths are still not materialized by this fixture

non_claims.meaning: parser-stub provenance field, not an authority to execute or compare

shape.required_rule: shape must equal f'{state_count}x{step_count}' after strict positive-int validation

required_rejections_before_boundary_meta: any required field set to null
unknown parser_payload keys outside the parser-stub handoff keyset
state_count or step_count that is bool, zero, negative, or non-int
shape mismatch after strict positive-int validation
mdir or top_module missing, null, empty, or non-string
ordinary_verilator_args, source_files, filelists, defines, include_dirs, or warning_flags missing or not list[str]
non_claims missing, empty, or not list[str]
parser_payload containing any sidecar-owned field listed by the direct fixture SIDECAR_OWNED_FIELDS
missing explicit sidecar_context target, mode, template_or_target_registry_entry, or source_gate_or_manifest_ref
validation_order: validate exact parser-stub keyset and required value semantics
validate preserved build-input field types and non-empty mdir/top_module
only then copy parser_payload and return reference-only sidecar_plan_boundary metadata
required_tests_for_next_implementation: parser_payload missing schema_version rejects before sidecar_plan_boundary metadata is returned
parser_payload missing surface rejects before sidecar_plan_boundary metadata is returned
parser_payload with surface other than native_verilator_parser_stub_fixture rejects
parser_payload missing mdir rejects before parser_preserved_build_inputs are returned
parser_payload missing top_module rejects before parser_preserved_build_inputs are returned
parser_payload with non-list or non-string build-input list entries rejects
parser_payload with bool state_count or bool step_count rejects before shape comparison
parser_payload with unknown non-sidecar keys rejects as outside the parser-stub handoff keyset
parser_payload with sidecar-owned fields still rejects before all boundary metadata
valid parser-stub payload from expanded argv still returns reference-only boundary metadata with all execution and measurement flags false

required_next_gate.name: review_verilator_native_option_parser_direct_command_path_fixture_payload_validation_hardening_gate
must_decide: whether exact parser-stub handoff keyset validation is the correct minimum hardening boundary
whether source_boundary_status, state_and_report_naming_rules, and non_claims are classified clearly as parser-stub provenance fields rather than execution authority
whether list[str] validation and non-empty mdir/top_module checks are sufficient before returning preserved build-input metadata
whether the next implementation may harden the existing importable helper in place or must split reusable validation to stay under line guards
whether sidecar stage materialization, command execution, timing, source-closure inference, filelist expansion, runtime/ABI changes, and automatic allocation remain out of scope
must_not_claim: coverage-output equivalence for a direct native-parser flow

non_claims: not native Verilator parser implementation completion
not coverage-output equivalence for a direct native-parser flow
not source-closure or filelist dependency inference
not automatic optimal GPU allocation for any design
reports and artifacts are generated evidence, not source of truth
